raw_text:
PLAN "Deload Week 5"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "reduce fatigue and maintain movement patterns"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 2x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Lower Body Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Light Recovery Cardio + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 1x20m rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          cat_cow 2x6..8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Deload 2":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 2x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Deload 2":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 2x3..4 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          split_squat 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 1x20m rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          pigeon_pose 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
          figure_four_stretch 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
          lat_stretch 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
          spinal_twist 2x30 rpe 3 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Restorative Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 3m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x60 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          wrist_circles 2x10..12 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10..12 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          cat_cow 2x6..8 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          child_pose 2x45 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m

goals.name: reduce fatigue and maintain movement patterns
